name: Adelaide University
description: Adelaide University is a public university in Adelaide formed by merging the University of Adelaide and the University of South Australia. It began teaching under its new name in 2026.
whyIncluded: Its medical degree is recognised by the Singapore Medical Council for practice in Singapore. One of the 10 universities in Australia most popular with international students; Australia is one of the nine places Singaporeans most often study abroad (about 6,800 Singaporean students, UNESCO data).

livingCosts.summary: Adelaide University's own guide to student living costs in Adelaide (rent, utilities, groceries, transport, phone, personal items, clothing and study materials), using the middle of its ranges.
livingCosts.notes: Adelaide University FAQ 'What is the cost of living in Adelaide?' (last modified 11 Jul 2025; moved to ask.adelaideuni.edu.au, re-read 2026-10-14: accommodation, groceries, utilities and phone ranges unchanged; the 28-day pass, personal care, clothing, study-materials and OSHC amounts below come from the page as read 2026-10-07 and are no longer on it), range midpoints converted to monthly (weekly x 52/12): accommodation AUD$150-$600+ per week (375/wk = 1,625) + utilities (private rental) $150-$300 per month (225) = housing 1,850; groceries $60-$200 a week (130/wk = 563.33); public transport 28-day pass $27.80 (x 13/12 = 30.12); personal = mobile phone $25-$110 a month (67.50) + personal care $25-$70 a month (47.50) + clothing $50-$100 a month (75) + study materials $500-$1,500 a year (83.33) = 273.33. Excluded: dining out ($15-$30 a meal), car ownership ($50-$100 a week), OSHC ($580-$4,000 a year). The accommodation range is open-ended ('$600+').
